## Checklist

- [ ] I edited the canonical source, not `dist/` or `plugins/`.
- [ ] `python3 magenta.py validate`, `build`, and `check` pass.
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` passes. I added tests for new behavior.
- [ ] Prose follows ASD-STE100. Diagrams are in Mermaid.
- [ ] I added a line to `CHANGELOG.md` under "Unreleased".
- [ ] For a durable decision: I added an ADR in `docs/adr/`.
- [ ] For a change to agents, rules, skills, or models: I ran the evals, or I explain why not.
